fact: A May 2025 investigation found that, apart from the Health ministry at about 80% of its transfer, no state institution had migrated its data to the Diamniadio national data centre despite the 2021 presidential instruction.
title: Souveraineté numérique du Sénégal : le vrai, le faux, le flou du Datacenter de Diamniadio (Enquête)
